name: face3d-modeling-toolkit
description: Quality-gated multi-view reconstruction, template fitting, mesh refinement, and same-geometry appearance skills for faces, stylized characters, and objects.

interface.shortDescription: Quality-gated reconstruction and geometry refinement skills.
interface.longDescription: Route and audit multi-view reconstruction, fit continuous templates for faces or objects, refine bounded regions, validate topology and provenance, and apply appearance without moving accepted geometry.
defaultPrompt: Use $face3d-modeling-toolkit:face3d-toolkit-router to choose the safe workflow for this 3D task.
Use $face3d-modeling-toolkit:reconstruct-3d-from-multiview to build an unskinned object preview from 2D evidence.
Use $face3d-modeling-toolkit:same-geometry-skin to apply appearance without moving accepted geometry.
